Item.Name: ROLL_FROM_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter rollover run from date in the format MMDDYY.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 dummy number;
 v_local_time DATE;
begin

 -- Converts GMT date to local date
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value = 'Y' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 --
 
 if :ctrl_blk.roll_from_date is null then
 show_error('0080');
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_blk.roll_from_date> trunc(v_local_time) then
 show_error('7022');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

end;

Item.Name: SPONSOR_ID
Item.Hint: Enter sponsor ID or select from [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chk number;
 run_lov boolean;
begin
 if :ctrl_blk.sponsor_id is not null then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into chk
 from rollover_run_log a, sponsors b 
 where a.rollover_run_date between :ctrl_blk.roll_from_date 
 and :ctrl_blk.roll_to_date 
 and a.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id 
 and ( b.sponsor_id = :ctrl_blk.sponsor_id 
 or b.name like :ctrl_blk.sponsor_id || '%' );
 if chk > 1 then
 run_lov := show_lov('lov_sponsor');
 if run_lov = FALSE then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 elsif chk = 1 then
 select sponsor_id
 into :ctrl_blk.sponsor_id
 from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = :ctrl_blk.sponsor_id
 or name like :ctrl_blk.sponsor_id || '%';
 else
 show_error('11047');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11047');
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_NAVIGATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SET_NAVIGATION (F_NAME IN VARCHAR2,FLG IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 IF FLG = 'T' THEN 
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_false);
 set_item_property(F_NAME,ENABLED,PROPERTY_false);
 END IF;
END;
